name: Stetson Property Management
subject: Furniture repair for your units
body:
Hi Stetson Property Management team,

I'm Dillon with Lerega, an upholstery and leather repair shop in Lakeway. When a sofa or chair in one of your units gets damaged, we pick it up, repair it and bring it back, often faster than ordering a new one. We also do better pricing for multiple properties.

Who on your team would be the right person to talk to about this?

subject: Handbag restoration
body:
